Hands-on, **day-by-day mini-courses**: each day is a single focused lesson — intuition-first explanation, a deep code walkthrough with the methodology explained line by line, theme-matched visuals, and a **🧪 Your task** exercise with a hidden solution. Pair them with the [AI & ML Encyclopedia](ai-ml-encyclopedia.html) for the theory behind every step.
